name: Whispers from the Dark: Grandma's Helper
summary: A psychological horror set in rural Thailand. After receiving a mysterious message, a university student returns home to help her grandmother sell grilled meat skewers with sticky rice. But between the smoke of the grill and the whispers of the villagers, a terrifying truth begins to emerge.
